name: Himalaya Food International Limited
about: Himalaya Food International Limited, a food processing company, grows and processes mushrooms in India and internationally. It operates through Agriculture and Processed Foods segments. The company offers fresh and canned mushroom-based products; cheese; snacks; sweets; fry-frozen potato products; French fries; and frozen appetizers. It also provides IQF ready to eat items. The company sells its products under the Himalaya and Chef Ernesto brands. It exports its products to the United States. Himalaya Food International Limited was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Paonta Sahib, India.
